question: Who among the following is the editor of 'Indian Renaissance: The Modi Decade'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Aishwarya Pandit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **'Indian Renaissance: The Modi Decade'** is edited by **Dr. Aishwarya Pandit**, a noted scholar and academician known for her research and contributions in the field of political and social studies.
 
• The book is a comprehensive analysis of **India's progress and transformation** during the tenure of **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, covering various aspects like governance, economic reforms, and policy-making.
 
• It compiles essays and research by experts and scholars, providing a multidimensional view of the achievements and challenges of the **Modi government**.
 
• The book delves into the themes of **nationalism**, **development**, and **cultural revival**, which have been key aspects of the Modi era.
 
• Published by **Rupa Publications**, this book has been widely regarded as a significant contribution to understanding the socio-political landscape of contemporary India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dr. Aishwarya Pandit:**

 
 
• Dr. Pandit is a renowned academic and writer with expertise in political science, history, and social studies.
 
• Her work often focuses on the intersection of **politics, society, and culture**, providing unique insights into contemporary issues.
 
• She has contributed to various scholarly articles, books, and journals, making her a respected voice in the field.
 
 
 
• **Rupa Publications:**
 
 
• One of India’s leading publishing houses, known for publishing books on **politics, history, literature, and culture**.
 
• It has a reputation for working with prominent authors and producing best-selling books.
 
• Some of its notable publications include works by **APJ Abdul Kalam, Shashi Tharoor, and Chetan Bhagat**.
 
 
 
• **Key Themes of the Book:**
 
 
• Focuses on the **economic and social reforms** introduced during the Modi decade, such as **Digital India**, **GST implementation**, and **Jan Dhan Yojana**.
 
• Explores the impact of the **Make in India** and **Swachh Bharat Mission** initiatives.
 
• Highlights the role of **cultural revival** and **nationalism** in shaping India's political discourse.
 
 
 
• **Other Contributors:**
 
 
• The book features contributions from various scholars, journalists, and experts, providing diverse perspectives on the subject matter.
 
• The essays analyze both the achievements and criticisms of the Modi government, ensuring a balanced view.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Indian Renaissance: The Modi Decade** is often regarded as a critical resource for understanding the socio-political and economic transformations in India during **2014-2024**.
 
• It provides an in-depth examination of **flagship schemes** like **Ayushman Bharat**, **Ujjwala Yojana**, and **Startup India**.
 
• The book also addresses India's evolving **foreign policy** strategies under Modi's leadership, including relations with neighboring countries and global powers.
 
• It is particularly useful for students, researchers, and anyone interested in India's political and economic journey in recent years.
